vetSays.line: A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.
💧 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.

"Hey." A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek.)

👀 the woman in her 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm talks about wanting to belong somewhere the way people talk about weather — often, and with no plans to change it. The real wanting is somewhere they keep not looking.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm).
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out to forage. "Back before dark. Probably." The pantry won't fill itself.

You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek telling A person, maybe 30s, with weathered hands about A woman, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
🌿 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns from foraging the wilds: +140 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 140 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.

🚶 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek: "I want to see what's out there too. Lead on."
You've started noticing: A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek and Yuki never speak. It's not new. (Something old lives in Haven.)

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
